criteria.criterion: Satu identitas pasien dan satu state longitudinal
criteria.acceptance: Satu pasien uji memiliki satu identitas; encounter, anamnesis, dan hasil merujuk ID yang sama (diuji lewat API, bukan UI saja)
evidence: server/uji/patientIdentityContinuity.uji.ts, imported by rekamEncounter.uji.ts in the mandatory server npm run uji (#2440, merge 1d193a9b; exact-head CI including Stabilization Acceptance and Validate changes passed before merge): actual application over HTTP in isolated file mode with random session secret and synthetic identities. One test account maps to one clinical id (self-u-<userId>); creating the patient twice updates in place and leaves exactly one patient record; the signed record, encounter close and successor record, lab result and referral all carry that same patientId, and the signed record keeps the authenticated doctor as signer and as author of each anamnesis answer even when the client forges the signer.

The same run shows the daily check-in (anamnesis) plan and the patient's answer stored against the same account id, and /api/keadaan-longitudinal keyed by that id joining the clinical records, encounters and care plans with reports for the same patient. A second account sees none of it and cannot write, file, answer or link into another identity (403/404/400/409 as applicable); a record cannot be filed under a different patientId; a patient session can create only its own primary record. A practice patient joins exactly one account through a one-time clinician-issued code: patients cannot issue codes, spent codes and already-linked patients cannot be reused or shared, and access ends when the link is removed.

Seven route-guard mutants (record patient mismatch, patient writes any id, patient issues link codes, link ownership, spent-code reuse, second-account link, check-in ownership) each fail by name; an eighth (removing the self-id candidate check) is not caught on purpose because the next line independently blocks the same case. Server typecheck, build and full npm run uji passed. Test-only change; no runtime code was modified. This is not human clinical approval.
criteria.note: VERIFIED only for technical identity continuity in file-mode application over HTTP. The clinical id (self-u-<userId>) and the care/longitudinal subject (the bare account id) are two deterministic forms of one identity, not one literal string. Lab results and referrals carry the same patientId but are served by their own RBAC routes, not inside /api/keadaan-longitudinal. Not covered: Mongo mode, legacy email-derived alias ids and email change, share expiry, and any UI. Doctor verification is a test fixture, not proof of qualification; clinically_reviewed stays false.

criteria.criterion: Encounter dibuat dan dipersist di backend
criteria.acceptance: Encounter yang dibuat tetap ada setelah restart server dan dapat dibaca ulang oleh pengguna berwenang
evidence: server/uji/encounterHttpRestart.uji.ts, imported by rekamEncounter.uji.ts in mandatory server npm run uji: actual application HTTP with temporary file persistence, random session secret and synthetic identities. Configured owner verifies doctor through the real API after an unverified-doctor denial; verified doctor creates patient, signs record with authenticated server-stamped identity/time/provenance, and closes encounter.

Application process exits before a new process starts on the same isolated file. Original doctor token reads the exact closed encounter and complete provenance, original signed record and distinct unsigned successor; current pointer and patient identity persist. Anonymous, unrelated patient and unverified doctor reads/writes/close are rejected 401/403; record/patient mismatch is rejected 400; even a verified doctor cannot close unsigned successor (409). Rejections leave snapshots and records unchanged.

Targeted HTTP/encounter fixture, full server npm run uji, server typecheck/build and standalone strict fixture typecheck pass. Removing actual closeEncounter snapshot persistence fails the named post-restart assertion; production source restored before final clean suites. Independent AI engineering review reproduced the actual HTTP restart fixture successfully and found no substantive bounded finding; this is not human clinical approval.
criteria.note: Technical encounter persistence acceptance in actual file-mode application processes, not Mongo encounter restart evidence, production patient-care verification, A1 longitudinal closure, A3/E2 completeness or human clinical authorization. Synthetic signing remains clinically_reviewed=false; clinician identity is obtained through the controlled owner-verification workflow.

criteria.acceptance: Jawaban anamnesis tersimpan bersama penulis, waktu, dan sumber; perubahan membuat versi baru, bukan menimpa
evidence: server/uji/anamnesisProvenanceVersioning.uji.ts, imported by rekamEncounter.uji.ts in the mandatory server npm run uji (#2444, merge 073e4c33; exact-head CI including Stabilization Acceptance and Validate changes passed before merge): actual application over HTTP in isolated file mode with synthetic identities. Each filled anamnesis answer stores source, author and a server-stamped time (client-claimed author/time ignored); editing one answer re-stamps only that answer; a signed record is never overwritten: a change archives the signed version (original wording, signer, per-answer provenance, who replaced it and when), strips the signature from the live record, and earlier archived versions stay unmodified. Eight source mutants fail by name. Test-only; not clinical approval.
criteria.note: REPORTED, not VERIFIED, because two parts of the acceptance are not met as written. (1) Versioning applies only to SIGNED records: an unsigned draft is edited in place and nothing is archived, so 'a change creates a new version, not an overwrite' is not true for drafts. (2) Provenance for non-clinician or AI-declared answers (asal 'AI') has a source and time but no author id (no olehId), so 'author' is present only for clinician-authored answers; a patient edit is labelled and archives the signed version it replaced, but the patient's identity is recorded on the archive (diarsipkanOleh), not on the answer. Decision for the ledger owner: either accept these as the intended model and promote, or change the runtime (version drafts; record the author id for patient/AI answers) and re-test. Not covered: Mongo mode, UI, AI-draft generation paths.

scripts/uji/body-gait-loop-reproduction.mts + src/domains/body-exposure/engine/gaitLoopSmoothness.ts (gerbang CI, reproduksi independen dari GLB publik via three+meshopt, tanpa Blender/numpy): salto kecepatan sudut pada emenda = |omega_akhir - omega_awal| dihitung ulang untuk WALK dan RUN pada adult_male dan vhf_denver_ct_adult_female dan dicocokkan dengan laporan Local dalam 0,1 deg/s (male RUN 250,7 deg/s di SHIN.R, WALK 132,1 di SHIN.L; female RUN 250,8, WALK 132,0), termasuk jumlah tulang beranimasi, tulang terburuk, dan median; batas teknis terdokumen (check_gait_loop.py) = salto di emenda tiap tulang <= maksimum salto antar-interval di dalam klip yang sama, diuji sebagai gerbang (daftar tulang di atas batas = kosong). Unit: kecepatan konstan, salto 20 deg/s eksak, q dan -q setara, emenda dengan tanda terbalik = 0, masukan tak sah melempar galat. Sabotase: 7 mutan (interval salah di awal/akhir, tanpa jalur terpendek, emenda tanpa abs, interior memakai min, omega tanpa dt, cek waktu monoton dihapus) masing-masing gagal dengan nama.

Run tidak dibatalkan oleh merge lain.
criteria.note: Alat sendiri menyatakan analisis kaki WALK/RUN eksperimental. Skrip QA di atas juga memutar klip Walk dan memeriksa kanvas berubah serta label "Recorded motion" (pemeriksaan fungsional, bukan kualitas gait). Jahitan nol sebagian hasil konstruksi (selisih akhir-awal disebar linear: 4,58° WALK, 12,39° RUN per DELTA.md), jadi bukan bukti kehalusan gerak; lompatan kecepatan sudut (RUN maks 250,7 °/dtk) belum direproduksi dan ambang 'batas teknis terdokumen' belum ditemukan. Tetap REPORTED. PEMBARUAN: lompatan kecepatan sudut kini direproduksi independen (male dan female) dan batas teknis 'salto emenda <= maksimum interior per tulang' diuji sebagai gerbang CI; dua kekurangan lama di catatan ini terjawab. Yang TETAP berlaku: emenda posisi 0 sebagian hasil konstruksi (selisih disebar linear), batas itu adalah pembanding internal klip - bukan bukti kualitas gait - dan analisis kaki WALK/RUN eksperimental. Gerbang kini punya run sukses di main (lihat bukti). PROMOSI KE VERIFIED hanya untuk kriteria sebagaimana tertulis (jahitan rotasi <= batas teknis terdokumen; kecepatan batas dilaporkan dan direproduksi independen untuk male dan female). Batas yang tetap berlaku: emenda posisi 0 sebagian hasil konstruksi; batas teknis adalah pembanding internal klip (bukan ambang tervalidasi pihak luar dan bukan bukti kualitas gait); analisis kaki WALK/RUN tetap eksperimental dan dinilai terpisah di D7.

scripts/qa/glb-foot-contact-reproduce.mjs + bodyexposure/qa_reports/gait_foot_contact_reproduction.{adult_male,vhf_denver_ct_adult_female}.json + scripts/uji/body-gait-foot-contact-reproduction.mts: reproduksi independen dari GLB publik (tanpa Blender), laporan = jalan ulang (deterministik). WALK jari jantan: 2 fase tumpu / 28 bingkai (fase melintasi jahitan loop dihitung SATU kali dan bingkai duplikat dibuang; laporan lama menghitung 3/29), v 1,327 m/s, RMS 12,6 mm, maks 32,2 mm (laporan lama 11,2 / 29,9; selaras). Penanda TUMIT tidak pernah menapak terhadap satu lantai klip di WALK maupun RUN (laporan lama menemukan 1 fase karena lantai per-penanda) sehingga angka tumit 24,5 mm bukan ukuran kontak yang sah. RUN: tanpa fase tumpu berdasarkan penanda; definisi titik terendah memberi 1 fase (3 bingkai). Betina: jari WALK 1 fase (5 bingkai). Definisi sol (simpul terendah) berderau karena identitas simpul berpindah tumit/jari (RMS 57,8 mm) dan tidak dibaca sebagai selip.

Penanda PLANTAR (simpul terendah di seperempat posterior/anterior kaki pada pose awal; scripts/qa/glb-foot-contact-reproduce.mjs): simpul ekstrem lama berada setinggi pergelangan, bukan telapak. Jantan WALK dengan penanda plantar: tumit 2 fase / 13 bingkai, RMS 7,8 mm, maks 16,6 mm; jari 2 fase / 24 bingkai, RMS 8,7 mm, maks 16,6 mm; tumit lepas lebih dulu daripada jari. Akar: hanya ayunan vertikal (y -0,0615..-0,0108 m), tanpa drift z, loop tertutup. Betina (tulang CT tanpa jaringan telapak): penanda plantar tidak menapak, kontak hanya via titik terendah kaki; RUN: kaki kanan 3 bingkai (<15 mm), kaki kiri hanya 2 bingkai (< minimum 3), jadi tidak terukur. Blender tidak tersedia di sesi ini, jadi tidak ada perubahan rig/mesh; temuan adalah kesalahan metodologi landmark, bukan cacat geometri yang dapat diperbaiki tanpa mengarang struktur.
criteria.note: Metodologi landmark dikoreksi: dengan penanda plantar, jantan WALK berada DALAM placeholder penelitian (RMS ≤ 15, maks ≤ 30 mm, ≥ 2 fase); penanda ekstrem lama melampaui maks (32,2 mm) karena bukan titik tumpu. Tetap REPORTED: ambang placeholder belum dibenarkan, rig tanpa tulang tumit/jari (penanda kaku ikut berguling, angka = batas atas), RUN dan betina tidak terukur.

criteria.acceptance: Akses tanpa identitas ditolak; sesi tidak dapat dipalsukan (tes negatif)
evidence: server/uji/authAccess.uji.ts

server/uji/authSessionHttp.uji.ts, dipanggil authAccess.uji.ts dalam server npm run uji: server aplikasi nyata, port loopback bebas, dua identitas sintetik tersimpan, berkas sementara dan secret JWT acak. Anonim 401; delapan kelas sesi tidak sah ditolak 401 pada /api/auth/me dan /api/clinical melalui bearer maupun cookie. Sesi Alice/Bob sah membaca identitas tepat; percobaan negatif tidak merusak sesi sah.

Token dengan identitas Bob diganti tetapi tanda tangan Alice dipertahankan, kunci salah, alg none, kedaluwarsa, malformed, signature terpotong, principal hilang/tidak dikenal semuanya ditolak. Bearer tidak sah tidak jatuh ke cookie sah. NODE_ENV=production menolak dev-login meskipun ALLOW_DEV_LOGIN=true dan tidak mengeluarkan cookie sesi.

Reproduksi independen AI: fixture HTTP lulus. Tiga sabotase sumber nyata masing-masing gagal dengan asersi bernama: jwt.decode menggantikan jwt.verify; gerbang production dev-login dihapus; fallback cookie setelah bearer tidak sah. Sumber autentikasi produksi dipulihkan tanpa perubahan.
criteria.note: Bukti autentikasi sesi internal lewat HTTP nyata; bukan klaim pentest menyeluruh atau verifikasi layanan Google/OTP eksternal. Fixture membatasi data sintetis dan menonaktifkan Mongo/provider email. Penilaian klinis tidak berubah.

criteria.acceptance: Peran yang salah ditolak pada setiap rute data klinis
evidence: server/uji/rbacKlinis.uji.ts (terdaftar di server `npm run uji`): menjalankan server nyata (berkas data sementara, port bebas, login dev) dan memanggil 15 rute /api/clinical* sebagai anonim, pasien, dan dokter tanpa STR terverifikasi: anonim 401 di semua; pasien dan dokter tanpa STR ditolak sesuai matriks (403/404 sebelum efek; rute 200 hanya memuat data sendiri, diperiksa tidak bocor); id pasien asing 403 vs id sendiri 200 (berpasangan).
Kelengkapan: pemindai rute di index.ts gagal bila ada rute /api/clinical* yang tidak ada di matriks.

Sabotase (masing-masing gagal dengan nama): penjaga kepemilikan /vital dimatikan → 'pasien: POST /api/clinical/vital'; requireAuth dihapus dari /links → 'anonim harus 401: GET /api/clinical/links'; rute baru tanpa keputusan → 'rute klinis tanpa keputusan RBAC di matriks: GET /api/clinical/rahasia'.

server/uji/rbacKlinis.uji.ts: fase HTTP tambahan setelah matriks 15 rute memverifikasi dokter melalui endpoint owner yang sah, membuat pasien praktik p1 dengan rekam privat nyata, menolak pembacaan/daftar kedua pasien tanpa tautan, menguji dua identitas self-u-<userId> dengan baca/tulis sendiri 200 dan akses silang 403, lalu membuktikan kode tautan dokter hanya memberi akses ke akun penebus; akun lain tetap 403 tanpa tautan.

Sabotase tambahan: penjaga kepemilikan sementara mengizinkan pasien asing yang benar-benar tersimpan. Matriks id asing yang belum ada tetap lulus, tetapi fase baru gagal tepat pada unlinked patient cannot read existing private p1. Penjaga runtime dipulihkan sebelum uji bersih targeted/full server, typecheck, build, dan typecheck ketat fixture lulus.

server/uji/labReferralHttpRbac.uji.ts, imported by mandatory hasilLab.uji.ts: nine actual HTTP lab/referral routes have an exact route-coverage matrix. Anonymous requests are 401; patients and effective unverified doctors read only their genuinely populated self-u subjects, cannot intake/advance or read staff metrics; unrelated existing IDs are concealed with 404 and filtered lists. Configured owner verifies a synthetic doctor via the real API; doctor transitions have authenticated actor/time provenance, while owner intake/scheduling cannot grant clinical review/completion. Every denial compares exact clinician-visible collections before/after.

Real patient-ownership admission mutation fails the named populated-subject list exclusion assertion. Runtime source restored before clean targeted/full-server suites, typecheck/build and strict fixture typecheck. Development/file-mode synthetic fixtures only; lifecycle reviewed is not human clinical validation.

Existing mandatory server/uji/labShareHttpRbac.uji.ts covers all12 registered lab-log/lab-share routes: anonymous401, populated own-only patient data, verified named-doctor role, unrelated doctor, review/write bounds and immediate revocation. careHttpRbac.uji.ts covers every /api/care route, patient-only report ownership, server-derived subjects, replacement and revocation. shareExpiryHttp.uji.ts controls persisted grant expiry across a process restart and checks all dependent clinician/care/longitudinal read routes; secondOpinionHttpRbac.uji.ts checks private patient views and verified-clinician completion. These named scenarios passed exact-source server CI job115638357170, and were reproduced locally on integrated main7127b799.

The supplementary careHttpRbac regression checks anonymous longitudinal reads, a populated own care-plan projection, and a second patient forging subjectId/email query parameters: the response remains keyed to the authenticated second patient with no foreign care plans. Removing the clinician lab-share role guard temporarily causes the existing mandatory suite to fail by name: patient GET /api/clinician/lab-shares (200 vs403). Original runtime bytes restored before clean labShareHttpRbac, careHttpRbac and shareExpiryHttp passes.
criteria.note: The previously recorded missing lab/care HTTP evidence is reconciled with existing mandatory suites; original clinical and lab/referral route matrices remain intact. Development/file-mode synthetic fixtures, not medical review, multitenant certification or live production acceptance. Exact-head candidate checks remain required before integration.

criteria.note: Kriteria baru ke-44 disetujui oleh pemilik 2026-10-14. A8 adalah E2E backend, bukan bukti browser user journey produk; jangan menghitung A8/B7 sebagai verifikasi otomatis task ini.

criteria.acceptance: Audit dan perbaiki halaman aktif yang masuk cakupan perjalanan kritis serta navigasi global dengan desain adaptif yang konsisten: tipografi, token warna PanaceaMed, hirarki visual, fokus dan keyboard, label semantik, kontras WCAG 2.2 AA, target sentuh sekurangnya 44px sesuai standar repo, responsivitas 390x844 dan desktop tanpa overflow, state kosong atau loading atau error, pembatalan atau pemulihan, dan reduced motion. Lampirkan inventaris halaman, hasil audit aksesibilitas otomatis ditambah pemeriksaan manual terarah, regresi screenshot lintas viewport dan tema, serta pengukuran performa yang metodologinya tercatat. Temuan kritis harus dituntaskan atau tetap berstatus belum VERIFIED; hindari klaim validasi pengguna yang tidak diuji.
